name: IMCD N.V.
summary: IMCD N.V. distributes, markets, and sells specialty chemicals and ingredients in the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, North America, South America, and the Asia-Pacific. The company offers surfactants and biocides; active pharmaceutical and nutraceutical ingredients, and excipients and specialty solvents; actives, emollients, rheology modifiers, emulsifiers, and decorative powders; and resins and binders, additives, pigments, and specialty solvents. It also provides texturants, proteins, flavors and colors, enzymes and cultures, natural fibers, and nutrition ingredients; synthetic base oils, specialty additive packages and components, purification media and catalysts, and process liquids; catalysts, and building blocks; adhesives solution, and polymers and specialty compounds; functional additives, fillers, and reinforcements; and resins and advanced composites, and pigments. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands.
